errors.evidence: The description omits the visible title of the chart, which is '段落乱序数据' (Paragraph out-of-order data).
The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis has tick marks at 0.2, 0.4, etc. The axis actually shows categorical ranges: '0~0.2', '0.2~0.4', '0.4~0.6', '0.6~0.8', and '0.8~1.0'.
